title: Storage quotas: each person's uploads against a quota, and StorageUse
spec: REQUIREMENTS 2.4. DEFAULT_QUOTA = 10 GiB per person; DurableServer::with_quota and quota. storage_used(user): the sizes of every file record the person uploaded, attached or not, except files whose message was deleted (imported files belong to the archive owner). begin_upload refuses with OverQuota (E_OVER_QUOTA, 12), before any byte is received, when used + uploads in progress + size would pass the quota; reaching it exactly is fine. Request 25 StorageUse (no fields) answers Ok { cursor: used } and an id frame of storage_frame(used, quota) (two big-endian u64; storage_of reads it); the memory backend answers E_NO_STORAGE.
